item.title: Your Brain on MCP: Who’s Ready for Total Freedom?
item.dc:creator: Greg Griffith
item.description: Underneath all of it sits a new kind of uncertainty, one the old screens largely spared him. A fixed interface told him, in effect, which questions could be asked. Now every question can be asked, and he is left to wonder: Am I asking the right questions? Am I requesting the right data? Am I framing the goals of the assessment correctly? Have I told the assistant enough about how to visualize the results, and how to convey what they mean? No error message will tell him he got any of these wrong. The answer comes back fluent and confident.
